newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES TO FALL NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES TO FALL NEXT WEEK.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would fall by three cents per litre and diesel would fall by five cents with effect from July 2.
Illuminating paraffin would fall by one cent per litre.
The Central Energy Fund said move followed declines in international product prices.
From July 2 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will be 214.0 cents. At the coast the price goes to 203.0.
The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 202.0 cents and 191.0 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 119.73 cents in Gauteng and 106.43 at the coast.
